meta.name: wan-2-7
meta.description: Generate text-to-video with Wan 2.7 (Wan-AI's flagship motion model) on RunComfy. Documents Wan 2.7's strengths (multi-reference conditioning, audio-driven lip-sync via `audio_url`, smoother transitions, prompt expansion), the duration / resolution / aspect-ratio schema, and when to route to HappyHorse 1.0 / Seedance 2.0 / Kling / LTX 2 instead. Calls `runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-2-7/text-to-video` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "wan", "wan 2.7", "wan-2-7", "wan video", or any explicit ask to generate video with this model.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速将文字描述转化为视频。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn text descriptions into videos.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能调用 Wan 2.7 模型生成视频。你可以描述画面、上传音频实现口型同步，或指定时长、分辨率、宽高比等参数。
howto.when: 当你提到“wan”、“wan 2.7”、“wan-ai”、“alibaba video”等关键词，或明确要求用该模型生成视频时触发。

say.text: 用 Wan 2.7 生成一段 5 秒 1080p 的视频，画面是日落海滩。
say.note: Claude 会调用模型生成视频并返回结果。

say.text: 上传这段音频，用 Wan 2.7 生成口型同步的视频，时长 10 秒。
say.note: 需要提供音频 URL，模型会驱动人物口型匹配音频。

say.text: 用 Wan 2.7 生成 9:16 竖屏视频，分辨率 720p，时长 8 秒。
say.note: Claude 会按指定参数生成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate videos using the Wan 2.7 model. You can describe the scene, upload audio for lip-sync, or specify duration, resolution, aspect ratio, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "wan", "wan 2.7", "wan-ai", "alibaba video", or explicitly ask to generate video with this model.

say_en.text: Use Wan 2.7 to generate a 5-second 1080p video of a sunset beach.
say_en.note: Claude will call the model and return the video.

say_en.text: Upload this audio and use Wan 2.7 to generate a lip-sync video, 10 seconds long.
say_en.note: Provide an audio URL; the model will sync lip movements.

say_en.text: Use Wan 2.7 to generate a 9:16 vertical video, 720p, 8 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the video with specified parameters.
